# sherpa-select-radio

A labelled radio button.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Built on | the native `<label>`, which gives click-forwarding |
| Figma | Select Radio |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-select-radio/sherpa-select-radio.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-select-radio/sherpa-select-radio.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-select-radio/sherpa-select-radio.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-select-radio/sherpa-select-radio.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-select-radio/sherpa-select-radio.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-select-radio data-label="Standard shipping" data-description="3–5 business days." name="ship" value="standard"></sherpa-select-radio><sherpa-select-radio data-label="Express" name="ship" value="express"></sherpa-select-radio>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-description` | text |  | helper line below the label |
| `data-label` | text |  | label text to the right of the dot (or default slot) |
| `checked` | boolean, native | `false` | native checked state (also a JS property) |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | native attributes, mirrored to the inner control |
| `name` | text, native |  | native attributes, mirrored to the inner control |
| `required` | boolean, native | `false` | native attributes, mirrored to the inner control |
| `value` | text, native |  | submitted value when selected |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` | `boolean` | read and write |  |
| `value` | `string` | read and write |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | read and write |  |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions)` | Focus its control: the first focusable part inside. |
| `checkValidity()` | Is it acceptable, as its form sees it? |
| `reportValidity()` | Check, and show the browser's message on the control. |
| `formDisabledCallback()` | Inside a disabled `<fieldset>`, as by its own `disabled`. |
| `formResetCallback()` | A form reset puts back its FIRST `checked`. |
